policy: Occupation demand records are publishable only when the shortage claim has a primary-source reference (official shortage list, government labour market report, or employer body publication). Demand level must not be inferred from anecdote or media reports.

records.sourceAuthority: Make it in Germany / Federal Employment Agency
records.notes: IT and software occupations appear on the German shortage occupation list (Engpassberufe). Chancenkarte points route available without job offer. Recognised foreign IT qualification or 5+ years experience qualifies.

records.sourceAuthority: Make it in Germany / Federal Employment Agency
records.notes: Mechanical, electrical and civil engineering on German shortage list. Chancenkarte available. Degree recognition via ANABIN required.

records.sourceAuthority: Make it in Germany / Federal Employment Agency
records.notes: Nurses, care workers and medical professionals on German shortage list. Professional recognition required from relevant German authority (e.g. Landesamt). Language requirement typically B2 German for clinical roles.

records.sourceAuthority: Make it in Germany / Federal Employment Agency
records.notes: Care work (Pflegekraefte) is on the German shortage occupation list. Pflegekarte route available for qualified care workers. Lower language bar than clinical nursing (B1 accepted for some roles). Qualification recognition via Anabin required. Chancenkarte points route also available.

DAMA regional stream covers trades including electricians, plumbers, carpenters and welders in designated regional areas. Employer sponsorship required. Age limit extended to 55 under DAMA concessions.
Nurses and allied health professionals on Australian skilled occupation lists. Points-based routes (189, 190, 491) available. AHPRA registration required for clinical roles.
NHS nursing and allied health on UK Immigration Salary List. Skilled Worker visa with NHS employer sponsorship. NMC registration required for nurses. Salary threshold set by NHS pay bands.

Software developers and IT professionals on Skilled Worker eligible occupations list. Employer sponsorship required. Minimum salary GBP 38,700 general threshold or occupation going rate, whichever is higher.

Skilled trades including electricians, plumbers and construction trades on UK Immigration Salary List. Skilled Worker visa with employer sponsorship. Minimum salary GBP 30,960 for most trades roles. Qualification recognition via UK NARIC may be required.

High demand for domestic workers in Qatar. Agent-mediated route. Kafala system applies - worker tied to employer. Minimum wage QAR 2,000/month. High risk category - agent vetting required before any referral. Do not refer without verified agent.

Qatar construction and trades sector has sustained demand for mechanics, electricians and general trades workers. Employer-sponsored visa. Agent-mediated for most African applicants. Official processing 2-4 weeks minimum - any agent claiming 3-5 days is not using the official process. Kafala system applies. High risk category.

records.sourceAuthority: UAE Ministry of Human Resources and Emiratisation
records.notes: UAE hospitality sector (hotels, restaurants, retail) has sustained demand for semi-skilled workers. Employer-sponsored visa required. Agent-mediated for most African applicants. Verify agent registration with MOHRE before referral.

records.sourceAuthority: UAE Ministry of Human Resources and Emiratisation
records.notes: UAE construction sector has demand for general labour and unskilled workers. Employer-sponsored visa. Agent-mediated. Wage theft and document confiscation are documented risks. Agent vetting required. Do not refer without verified agent.

Oman has documented demand for trades workers including car mechanics, electricians, AC technicians and plumbers in Muscat and other cities. Employer-sponsored work visa. Standard processing 2-4 weeks. Salary range OMR 150-300/month for trades. Employer typically provides accommodation and food. Kafala partially reformed since 2021 - workers can change employers without sponsor permission.

IT and software roles on Irish Critical Skills Eligible Occupations List. Critical Skills Employment Permit available. Salary threshold EUR 38,000 for most IT roles. Path to stamp 4 (unrestricted work) after 2 years.
Software and IT occupations (NOC TEER 1-2) score well in Express Entry. Federal Skilled Worker Program available. CRS score determines invitation. Tech draws have been category-based since 2023.

Canada Francophone Community Immigration Pilot (FCIP) actively targets French-speaking care workers, PSWs and home child care providers outside Quebec. Eligible occupations: NOC 33102 (PSW), NOC 44100 (home child care), NOC 44101 (caregiver for adults). French CLB 5 minimum required. Direct path to permanent residence. Ontario alone needs 50,000+ PSWs by 2028. Salary CAD 18-22/hour for PSW roles.

Warehouse and logistics workers in sustained demand across Canada. LMIA employer-sponsored route. Employers in logistics (Amazon, Walmart, third-party logistics) actively sponsor foreign workers. Salary CAD 18-22/hour. No degree required. Verify employer LMIA approval before paying any agent fees.

Trades and technician occupations on NZ Skilled Migrant Category trades list. Direct residence pathway via SMC Trades and Technician route. Current NZ employment required. Qualification recognition needed.

Saudi Arabia has high demand for domestic workers. Kafala system applies. Agent-mediated. Domestic workers have limited legal protections. High risk category. Do not refer without verified, licensed agent. Saudi Vision 2030 labour reforms ongoing but domestic worker protections remain weak.

Portugal tech sector growing. D3 Highly Qualified Activity visa available for software professionals. Lower salary threshold than UK/Germany. NHR tax regime attractive for first 10 years. Lisbon and Porto tech hubs.

Singapore Employment Pass for software and IT professionals. COMPASS points framework applies since 2023. Minimum salary SGD 5,000/month (higher for financial services). Degree required. COMPASS scores on salary, qualifications, diversity and local workforce support. Tech roles in fintech, cloud, cybersecurity in high demand.
